details: Charles Schwab, a major financial services company overseeing approximately $12 trillion in client assets, has begun rolling out direct spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading within its brokerage platform for eligible retail clients. This move integrates crypto into a mainstream investment network, potentially driving significant new digital asset flows.
title: Charles Schwab Launches Direct Spot Crypto Trading

details: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee is currently reviewing more than 100 proposed amendments to the CLARITY Act, a significant piece of crypto market structure legislation. With over 40 amendments from Senator Elizabeth Warren alone, the bill faces contentious debate over stablecoin and banking disputes, with a critical markup vote scheduled for Thursday.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Over 100 Amendments Before Key Senate Vote

details: JPMorgan has filed for dual tokenized money market funds, leveraging both the Ethereum and Solana blockchains. This initiative underscores increasing institutional adoption of crypto and highlights a multi-chain strategy for integrating tokenized assets into traditional finance.
title: JPMorgan Files for Dual Tokenized Funds on Ethereum & Solana

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced significant outflows totaling $630 million. These outflows are raising concerns among investors regarding corporate treasury demand and potential resistance building for the cryptocurrency, suggesting a "rally without conviction" in the current market environment.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Record $630M Outflows Amidst Market Concern

details: Higher-than-expected Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) data have reignited concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes. This macroeconomic pressure is negatively impacting risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, as inflation fears influence investor sentiment and market outlook.
title: Hot CPI Data Stirs Fed Rate Hike Fears, Pressuring Crypto
